title: inference-domain-chat-verb
intention: The chat verb on the sole path: inference_domain's host.py opens ollama's /api/chat (today it opens /api/generate and /api/embed only), metered with the standing discipline (HostUnmetered refuses a counterless answer loudly), wired through route()/resolve() so a chat request canonicalizes and caches like any other. Non-streaming first (the consumer runs aider --no-stream; build minimal, grow against need). NOTHING CONSUMER-SHAPED RIDES WITH IT: this ticket originally carried a fourth domains row named builder-aider, and Akien's ruling of 2026-08-16 killed it (see distinctions). The verb is a verb — the consumer asks for hex and qwen3-coder:30b by name, and the proxy answers what it is asked.
why: The parent aider-shim's builder converses in chat-messages format, and the ruled shape is that its traffic rides the proxy so the system learns from it — but the sole path has no chat verb, so today that traffic CANNOT be ruled. This child is the critical-path prerequisite named at cast: built and proved first, so the shim lands on a solid layer (solidify the layer below).
traces_to: Law 4 (the escalation fence and model pin are rows the nest sieves — physics, not policy); Law 3 (an unmetered answer refuses rather than metering zero — the /api/embeddings lesson host.py already records); Telos 1 (every chat call becomes spent-vs-avoided data in the meter); parent aider-shim's Law 1 case.

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam invariants: proved (tester netns seal beside inference_domain's existing validations) + feeds back to origin on failure. Entry: BUILDME refuses without intent_berth, sorted_berth, and a berthed validate packet claiming this ticket. Exit: verdict artifact then clearance (inference_domain's charter gates the write). The proofs must grip both falsifier tells — counters present, fence holds — so a hollow build (a verb that answers but meters nothing) cannot pass.
falsifier.proves_red: Done-tell: a chat request routed route(kind='chat', model='qwen3-coder:30b') — no domain named, riding the general default like any other call — answers from hex.local with real token counters metered into yield_report. Wrong-tell: chat responses carry no counters (the verb cannot be metered — design kicks back) or chat cannot canonicalize for the cache. NOT A DONE-TELL ANY MORE, and the correction is the ticket's own: the original falsifier demanded domain='builder-aider' and a fence proving that domain could never dial a non-hex provider. That fence was built, watched to fail, sealed — and then removed by ruling. A falsifier naming a row that must not exist would make this ticket unprovable-by-construction, so it is restated rather than left to rot.
falsifier.horizon: One verb at one address: host.py chat method, route/resolve wiring, proofs. No new domains row — the stack stays at the three ruled verticals. The parent's first shimmed ticket exercises it for real; its own proofs seal it before that.
